**Abbey · Start**
Choose a section. Commands below are permitted here; execution rechecks readiness.

`/help` (slash command; private) · Browse commands available to you privately.
`/stats` (slash command; private) · Read this conversation’s learning and reply budget.

Task buttons open private workflows. Use the section menu for the command reference.

Provider health is checked when you run a command. Controls expire 15 minutes after opening; `/help` starts a new private session.

**Abbey · Conversation**
Choose a section. Commands below are permitted here; execution rechecks readiness.

`/persona route` (slash command; channel-visible) · Choose a persona and explain the routing.
`/persona ask` (slash command; channel-visible) · Ask a question through the configured generation backend.
`/roleplay` (slash command; channel-visible) · Roleplay as Aviva in a DM or NSFW channel when the nsfw gate is on.
`Ask Abbey` (message menu; private) · Ask about a selected message privately.
`/summarize` (slash command; channel-visible) · Summarize the recent conversation through the backend.
`/nsfw` (slash command; private) · Enable or disable Aviva roleplay in this DM (in a server use /admin nsfw).

Open the message menu, then Apps, for its listed actions.

Provider health is checked when you run a command. Controls expire 15 minutes after opening; `/help` starts a new private session.

**Abbey · Memory**
Choose a section. Commands below are permitted here; execution rechecks readiness.

`/remember` (slash command; private) · Store a fact about yourself; moderators may choose a member.
`/forget` (slash command; private) · Remove a stored fact about yourself or an authorized member.
`/pending list` (slash command; private) · Review proposed fact replacements.
`/pending confirm` (slash command; private) · Apply an explicitly chosen fact replacement.
`/pending dismiss` (slash command; private) · Dismiss a proposed replacement and keep both facts.
`/recall` (slash command; private) · Read your facts and standing, or an authorized member's.
`/reputation` (slash command; private) · Read your standing privately; moderators may choose a member.
`Abbey: memory` (member menu; private) · Read the selected member's bounded memory card privately.

Open the member menu, then Apps, for its listed actions.

Provider health is checked when you run a command. Controls expire 15 minutes after opening; `/help` starts a new private session.

**Abbey · Images**
Choose a section. Commands below are permitted here; execution rechecks readiness.

`/see` (slash command; channel-visible) · Describe an image; an optional question also needs generation.
`/ocr` (slash command; channel-visible) · Read the text in an image.
`Abbey: describe image` (message menu; private) · Describe the first supported attachment privately.
`Abbey: read image text` (message menu; private) · Read text from the first supported attachment privately.

Open the message menu, then Apps, for its listed actions.

**Abbey · Server**
Choose a section. Commands below are permitted here; execution rechecks readiness.

`/whois` (slash command; channel-visible) · Read a member's profile and roles.
`Abbey: profile` (member menu; private) · Read the selected member's profile privately.

`/webhook` (slash command; private) · Show a safe incoming-webhook setup guide.
`/forum draft` (slash command; private) · Suggest #help tags and preview a first-post template.
`/forum post` (slash command; private) · Create a #help forum thread with a first-post template.
